about: The map's own land stamps (MapStamps, docs/design/maps-as-data.md section 3), laid on every peer when the world is made, after the rows, and kept off their laid land and water: no undo or reset takes them. Each is a land stamp: at [x, y] in cells, a profile, radius in cells, rise in land units (0.125 m), rough 0 to 100 and a seed, with a canyon's or cliff's line as along [x, y] or a path of points from at. A canyon's trail is the terrain laid along the middle of its floor. A crag's face and a deep floor are bare rock, and their trees go.
